entries.text: That’s terrible...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_01

entries.text: Ogerpon didn’t deserve that! And the Loyal\nThree—they’re the worst![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_02

entries.text: The story everyone’s been told is the complete\nopposite of the truth! They gotta hear about this![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_03

entries.text: Calm yourself, Carmine! I told you already to\nkeep it to yourself![VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_01

entries.text: But, Grandpa—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_04

entries.text: The villagers believe their own version of history.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_05

entries.text: They revere the Loyal Three—so how would they\nreact to being told that they’ve got it all wrong?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_06

entries.text: They’d probably get...angry?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_05

entries.text: Exactly.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_07

entries.text: Back when this all first occurred, the mask\nmaker—that is to say, our ancestor—tried\r\ndesperately to tell the truth of the matter.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_08

entries.text: But nobody would take him seriously. In fact, it’s\nsaid he was persecuted as a heretic.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_09

entries.text: Oooh, that REALLY gets my blood boiling![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_06

entries.text: In the end, the mask maker chose to protect his\ndescendants—us—by keeping his mouth shut.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_10

entries.text: However, he kept the truth alive—passed down\nfrom generation to generation as a family secret.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_11

entries.text: Kiki doesn’t know the whole story yet, does he?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_08

entries.text: He shouldn’t, no—I’ve certainly never spoken to\nhim about it. Why do you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_12

entries.text: I dunno. He just really seems to like the ogre...\nHe’s practically obsessed.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_09

entries.text: And he’s been trying to one-up me—as if he\nknows more about Ogerpon than I do.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_10

entries.text: Well, I can’t say what’s going on with the boy...\nbut he always was a sensitive child. It wouldn’t\r\nsurprise me if he’s somehow intuited the truth.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_13

entries.text: I promise to tell Kieran the whole story when the\ntime is right.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_14

entries.text: Until then, take care not to breathe a word of the\ntruth to anybody![VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_15

entries.text: OK, Grandpa...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_11

entries.text: Now I REALLY can’t tell Kiki we met the ogre...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_12

entries.text: About that mask you showed me...I noticed the\njewel on its forehead was chipped.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_16

entries.text: I might be able to fix it. Would you mind leaving\nthe mask with me for a little while?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_17

entries.text: Oh, huh. Maybe it got chipped when it fell down\nthe stairs?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_13

entries.text: Since Grandpa’s offering, let’s get it all nice and\nfixed up before we give it back to Ogerpon![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_14

entries.text: You gave the Teal Mask to Carmine’s grandfather!
entries.label: sdc01_0260_system_01

entries.text: Don’t you worry. I’ll be sure to take good care\nof this.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_18

entries.text: I wanna see Ogerpon again, but getting its mask\nfixed will have to come first.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_15

entries.text: For now, we should carry on with the orienteering\nbefore Kiki gets suspicious.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_16

entries.text: I bet we’ll find Kiki just killing time somewhere\nin town![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_17

entries.text: The boy I partnered up with is so...ordinary.\nPretty underwhelming, if I’m being honest.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_sister_18

entries.text:
You mustn’t tell anybody about the true history
of our village.\c
Now, I’d better get everything ready to fix the
ogre’s mask![VAR 0x0114(0030)]
entries.label: sdc01_0260_gfather_19
